change: HOUSE-KERNEL step 2 (docs/HOUSE-KERNEL.md, approved Oct 17): openings own their header, trim and limits. tools/house/openings.py -> spec/openings.json gives every opening (doors, arches, windows, prop doors, the landing window, the front door assembly) its casing pieces per face, its header and its limits (head under the header, under the ceiling, spring under crown, a leaf's swing clear to 90 deg), checked at data time: a breach is refused with its reason (exit 1, nothing written). Casing the opening does NOT carry is a recorded 'dropped' decision (runs into a wall; replaced by a pack door frame; plain arch). SpecGreybox lays the casing from that file (SpecGreybox.Openings.cs LayCasings; the per-case Trim() calls in Storey/ArchTop are off), and trim_faces.py cuts every run at the same boxes, so baseboard, cap and rail end at the casing by construction (selftest: 103 strip ends on a piece edge, worst 0.0 mm). Absorbs STATUS 8t-3 (the landing window's panelling now comes from the face trim: one wainscot height round the landing; hifi_landing_window.py drops its own panelling and cap and takes its legs, stool and apron from the opening record) and 8t-2 (the stool rested flush in the cut: the wall is now cut to the rough opening 3.5 cm under the stool, and the stool board fills it). The front door's frame is a piece of its opening, so FaceTrim no longer probes the model (LayTrim FrontDoor_HiFi). One switch: openings.py OWN_TRIM (written as own_trim; read by SpecGreybox, trim_faces.py and hifi_landing_window.py).
premise: A casing is cut to the opening it trims and the trim is cut to the casing: deriving both from the opening's own record (the same numbers the wall is cut from) reproduces today's casing exactly and closes the joints where three producers met by chance; the landing's walls are one wainscot (the stair's 0.705 from the foyer), which the window's casing interrupts until its sill is re-measured (8w)

The landing wainscot height is the stair's (foyer.json wainscot_m 0.705, Marina 312 s), carried round the landing (ASSUMED there: DEVIATIONS 66/67). No opening was re-measured; the landing window's sill and head are unchanged (8w is its own trial)
